about: Edits applied to data/gold_annotations_main_atomic.csv by scripts/apply_refinements.py to produce data/gold_annotations_main_atomic_refined.csv. The original CSV and the database are never modified. Edit this file and re-run the script to redo.

rules.scope: Ungrounded "For all users," -> <MISSING_SCOPE>; the annotator's scope slot implied -> missing.
rules.grid: Text brought in line with the annotator's own slot judgments; placeholders in segment order.
rules.then: "then" added after a condition (Rimay pattern: "when X, then Actor must ...").
rules.typo: Typos, punctuation, whitespace, stray newlines, missing final period, "app" -> "App".
rules.word: Wording that misstated the NL, fixed.
rules.opus: Phrasing guided by the Opus reference (main30opus), used only where the annotator's was wrong.

requirementNotes.5529-Signal: NL names a population ("non-passphrase users") - could be written as a real scope instead of <MISSING_SCOPE>.
requirementNotes.828-Signal: NL names a set ("TextSecure groups") - could be a real scope.
requirementNotes.245-Signal: NL names a set ("dual sim mobile") - could be a real scope.
requirementNotes.496-Signal: The title states the action ("change maximum size of MMS"), yet all three judged action missing. Slots left as they are.
